messages:
sylvie: Follow-up from the postmortem for the missing-spans + aggregation drift incident (INC-5842). Need owners, quick ETAs, and a regression detector so this doesn't slip.
noah: I'll take the ETL backfill and row-level validation. Plan: targeted backfill for affected partitions, then run an equivalence check against raw_events. ETA: Fri EOD.
tara: I'll own aggregation correctness and CI coverage. I'll add unit tests for null/empty spans and a staging integration that compares hourly buckets. Also will add a nightly synthetic-trace smoke job.
sylvie: Please create obs-remediations tickets, tag postmortem:INC-5842, and mark quick-fix (<=7d) vs long-term. Assign owners and due dates.
noah: Backfill SQL (sample):
```sql
INSERT INTO spans_agg (trace_id, span_id, start_ts, service, payload)
SELECT r.trace_id, r.span_id, r.start_ts, r.service, r.payload
FROM raw_events r
LEFT JOIN spans_agg s ON s.trace_id = r.trace_id AND s.span_id = r.span_id
WHERE r.event_type = 'span' AND r.partition_date = '2026-03-18' AND s.trace_id IS NULL;
```
I'll post row counts in the ticket.
tara: CI smoke: nightly synthetic traces asserting >=99.9% span preservation and that aggregation bucket counts match expected tolerances. Failures auto-open OBS-CI tickets.
sylvie: Monitoring/runbook: add a weekly "span-coverage" job comparing processed_span_count to raw_events baseline; alert if drop >15% sustained 20m. If alert fires, try automated retry/reprocess once before paging.
alerts-bot: Created OBS-1510: "span-coverage-weekly" assigned to tara (due 2026-03-27).
alerts-bot: Created OBS-1511: "etl-targeted-backfill" assigned to noah (due 2026-03-26).
sylvie: This pattern has recurred several times. Propose a monthly 30-min "obs-regressions" review to track trends and decide structural fixes (partitioning, compaction SLAs, stronger e2e tests). Who can commit?	noah: I'll join monthly and bring partition skew metrics + backfill cost.
tara: I'll join and bring CI failure timelines and test coverage gaps.
sylvie: OK. Everyone drop 1-2 bullets in their tickets by EOD tomorrow: scope, ETA, blockers. I'll compile and schedule three weekly check-ins to drive closure. If you hit blockers, ping me or @eng-oncall.
noah: Found one partition with delayed compaction that explains lag; including remediation notes in ticket.
tara: If backfill needs extra compute, we'll ask for short-term burst capacity and list approvals in ticket.
sylvie: Thanks all, closing this thread until updates are posted. :rocket:
